scope: Price-free purchasing article search for inventory roles, client selection/pagination and complete calculated-article redaction in existing inventory replies. Portal design only; no portal implementation or full acceptance A-G.

browser_e2e.initial_harness_errors: Two CDP response-body lifetime failures; genuine HTTP responses are now captured via route.fetch before forwarding. Final run passed, including unchanged lost-ACK receipt test.
browser_e2e.legacy_feature_test: Older-server behavior simulated by removing the new feature from a real capabilities response.

results.schema_preservation: No changes to existing DDL/guards; domain/HTTP/PostgreSQL reads and catalogue capability preserve stored schema checksums and rows.

regression_fixed: Calculated article pricing_snapshot and service components leaked through the old five-field inventory price denylist. Actual pricing_preview/save_article cases failed before the fix and pass after explicit seven-field projections on article snapshots and inventory lookup, including replay after financial access withdrawal.
limitations: Each catalogue page scans the article catalogue under the existing transaction lock; index-backed large-catalogue search remains future work.
Older servers without purchasing_catalog retain their documented limited fallback.
Supplier transmission, structured device/purchase linkage, original delivery documents and durable offline goods receipts remain open.
Portal plan is documented but portal routes and customer acceptance are not yet implemented.
Full acceptance A-G and actual Windows/iPhone installations remain open.
note: Test groups overlap and must not be added as unique acceptance counts. Raw logs reside in ignored work/verification; tests, reports and hashes are committed.
